headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Overweight on Essex Property Trust, Raises Price Target to $316
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Richard Anderson   maintains Essex Property Trust (NYSE:ESS) with a Overweight and raises the price target from $291 to $316.
